 News Flash
 City of Lynchburg – November 3, 2026, General and Special Election
 Communications & Public Engagement
 Posted on November 19, 2026 
 The City of Lynchburg Office of the General Registrar is pleased to report that voter turnout for the November 3, 2026, General and Special Elections was 51% . This represents meaningful participation by the citizens of Lynchburg and reflects the importance of providing our community with the opportunity to make their voices heard.
 Every election is an important part of our democratic process, and we are grateful to every voter who took the time to participate. Whether voting early or on Election Day, each voter plays a role in shaping the future of our community.
 Our office remains committed to ensuring that elections in Lynchburg are accessible, transparent, accurate, and conducted with integrity. We take great pride in the responsibility entrusted to us and work diligently to protect the confidence our citizens place in the election process.
 To the voters of Lynchburg, thank you for exercising your right to vote. To our election officers and election team, thank you for your service, your commitment, and your dedication to the citizens of our city.
 Elections are about more than numbers. They are about people, participation, public trust, and the right of every eligible citizen to have a voice.
